unknown_start: same public arena start region prior as v133; no seed-to-row or current dock identity supplied; fixed spawn x/all-row spread retained
success: unchanged posthoc lifted AND inside AND floor AND stable; no tuning/retry after outcome
initial_error: last saved pose with t <= first nonzero base command t, compared with saved evaluation trajectory at pose.t_est; if no base command, last saved pose with endpoint label
wall_contacts: positive force20Hz samples and contiguous episodes by wheel/body/finger/cargo vs wall
video: own RGB20Hz at4x; execution.mp4 per run
freeze_scope: S2 solo DEV only; no S3/pair/research use; results not pooled with discarded conditions
failure: record cause only; no fixes/retry; ENOSPC HOST_ERROR; actual physical failure terminates existing loop
lock: exclusive agent_lock; wait until null; ugrp_session sequential
pooling_scope: descriptive v133 baseline count: existing three seen successful DEV runs plus three new preregistered seeds; separate new/seen strata; no v135-v138 pooling; not unbiased research success rate
post_v133_options: absent/off; do not enable forward_scale, likelihood_tempering, look_before_move, final_approach
contact_metrics: all recorded pair contact points/samples/episodes with robot IDs; evaluate XY/yaw error before and after each episode; wall positive-force samples/points by wheel/body/finger/cargo; contacts never runtime inputs
pose_metrics: all recorded pulse decision/checkpoint times: NEES XY with one-cluster matching covariance trace; chi2_95=5.991464547107979, unflagged XY>0.25m; preserve denominators, information only
cohort_policy: each of three fixed seeds once; no fixes/retry/substitute seeds after failure; classify cause only
prior_look_before_move: v135-v138 deferred; retain prior records unchanged
